citations.claim: EW still yellow at step 123 when emergency becomes active, then cut off
NS turns green at step 124 with 0s all-red, first all_red_clearance violation
EW yellow lasted only 1s, yellow_duration violation at same step

counterfactual.change: Removed the single emergency event; otherwise identical. Without preemption the cycle respects yellow and all-red and no rule is violated.

explanation: Emergency preemption forces its direction green immediately: EW was green at step 122, yellow at 123 when emergency for S started, then NS green at 124. This truncates EW yellow to 1s (needs 6s) and skips the 2s all-red clearance entirely, causing simultaneous all_red_clearance and yellow_duration violations.

violation.detail: approach 0 turned green after only 0 s of all-red (need 2 s)

vision_note: The east-west approaches show green in steps 121-122 and then yellow in step 123 while north-south remains red. In step 124 the north-south approaches immediately turn green with no all-red interval in between.
